annotations.title: Book several APC shipments and print their labels

description: Book multiple APC shipments at once (up to 50), then fetch the labels. Every shipment booked costs money. PDF labels are merged into one file, ready to print; ZPL and PNG labels are saved as one file each. Use this when the user pastes a list of orders/addresses. All shipments share the same service, collection date and sender. A shipment that is booked but whose label could not be fetched is still reported with its waybill, so never book it again; use get_label instead. Saves to ~/Downloads/parcel-toolkit/ (overridable via PARCEL_TOOLKIT_LABELS_DIR).

collectionDate.description: Collection date for every shipment. YYYY-MM-DD or DD/MM/YYYY

labelFormat.description: Label format. PDF labels are merged into one file. ZPL (thermal printers) and PNG labels are saved as one file per shipment.

readyAt.description: Time goods will be ready HH:MM (default 09:00)

sender.description: Sender / collection address. Same for every shipment in the batch.

companyName.description: Company name (optional for collection if using account address)

instructions.description: Delivery instructions e.g. leave with neighbour (recipient only)

postcode.description: UK postcode. Include the space e.g. WS11 8LD

service.description: APC delivery service for every shipment in this batch (e.g. "next-day", "next-day-1200", "ND16"). Call list_services for the full catalogue.

shipments.description: Array of shipments to book, at most 50. Each entry is one consignment with its own recipient, weight and pieces.

numberOfPieces.description: Number of parcels/items for this shipment (1 to 50)

recipient.description: Recipient / delivery address for this shipment

companyName.description: Company name (optional for collection if using account address)

instructions.description: Delivery instructions e.g. leave with neighbour (recipient only)

postcode.description: UK postcode. Include the space e.g. WS11 8LD

reference.description: Internal order reference for this shipment

totalWeightKg.description: Total weight in kg for this shipment

name: book_batch_and_label
